$comment: The properties zpool create gives the pool that holds imp's datasets, as its arguments before the pool name. bun run render:deploy writes them into deploy/bootstrap/storage.sh and bootstrap.sh's copy; scripts/test-zfs.sh, scripts/zfs-host-test.sh and e2e/test-bootstrap.sh read this file. impd sets recordsize on the datasets it makes, so the pool's root keeps the default.
